## Conjoint Analysis

Stated-preference measurement of demand — designing choice experiments, estimating preferences from them, and turning the results into economic quantities.

#### Reviews & Foundations

 - Agarwal et al. (2015) An Interdisciplinary Review of Research in Conjoint Analysis: Recent Developments and Directions for Future Research [[link](https://doi.org/10.1007/s40547-014-0029-5)]
 - Ben-Akiva et al. (2019) Foundations of Stated Preference Elicitation: Consumer Behavior and Choice-based Conjoint Analysis [[link](https://doi.org/10.1561/0800000036)]
 - Chandukala et al. (2007) Choice Models in Marketing: Economic Assumptions, Challenges and Trends [[link](https://doi.org/10.1561/1700000008)]

 - Revelt & Train (1998) Mixed Logit with Repeated Choices: Households' Choices of Appliance Efficiency Level [[link](https://doi.org/10.1162/003465398557735)]
 - Marshall & Bradlow (2002) A Unified Approach to Conjoint Analysis Models [[link](https://doi.org/10.1198/016214502388618410)]
 - Fiebig et al. (2010) The Generalized Multinomial Logit Model: Accounting for Scale and Coefficient Heterogeneity [[link](https://doi.org/10.1287/mksc.1090.0508)]
